meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会当 5 人对抗团队的 Lead:成员互相攻击彼此的观点,它只挑出经得住攻击的洞见,再交给专门的规划者写成正式方案。
howto.when: 当你要求做 hyperplan,或需要最高严谨度的对抗式、交叉批判式规划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次数据库迁移
say.note: 启动 5 人对抗团队交叉批判,再出正式方案

say.text: 给我的方案做一次对抗式交叉批判
say.note: 成员互相攻击观点,只留经得住攻击的洞见

say.text: 用 hyperplan 重新规划,重点挑架构缺陷
say.note: 产出由专门的规划者正式写成

howto.what_en: Claude leads a 5-member hostile team whose members attack each other's findings, keeps only the defensible insights, and hands them to a dedicated planner to formalize.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or when you ask for a hyperplan / adversarial / cross-critique plan.

say_en.text: Run a hyperplan for my database migration
say_en.note: Starts the 5-member cross-critique, then a formal plan
Members attack each other; only survivors remain

say_en.text: Hyperplan this again, focus on architecture flaws
say_en.note: A dedicated planner formalizes the result
